title: Verify a one-native-fusion conditional compiler construction target
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**No physical pair is supplied and no new κ is admitted.** One hypothetical legal `H1+H1→H2` fusion in each of 18 native occurrences changes the complete p16/a7 paid invoice by exactly `−36 H1+18 H2`, with unchanged productive targets and rank mass. Under the retained source/finite/precision/compiler/outer cost contracts, the independently reviewed fixed scalar screen supports the construction target `κ=0.0030220`, tested at `0.00302200001` with reserve `10^-11`.

This is a changed-profile target and concrete construction handoff, not an improvement from more digits of an unchanged root. It is above the frozen #4610 value `0.0030217758`; the selected #4470 record remains unchanged. At #5226's larger fixed bar `0.0030233`, this exact type of change needs five fusions per native—90 global occurrences—for positive raw moment. That sign is not compiler or native admission for the larger bar.

## Task and overlap

**task_id: `independent-moment`. Scope change:** source-bound verification of #5226/#4610's fragmentation normalization and one fixed compiler point for the hypothetical `−36 H1+18 H2` profile, replacing any unchanged-root refinement or broad physical supplier claim. Only the fixed p16/a7 invoice is screened; exhaustive all-controller maxima, unshipped searches, broader centre/coded-family claims and physical pair discovery are outside this submission.

Sources: DreamingOfClouds' [#5226](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5226) head `dc5764630fdf34f72bbe76efd4b79d3b2bc3dd40`; Cao Yifan/intqwq's #4610 head `20bb93cd990d2ff683e4d0fc56b87a42cd5d3296`. Publication base `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf` was refreshed via the sole monitor/canonical fetch; governing guidance and selected record are unchanged. No duplicate PR-feed intake or source search occurred. A fresh bounded all-author check through 13:46 UTC found no matching target. The separate #5241 submission concerns admission of the existing #4610 value and does not supply this hypothetical physical delta.

The original author report `828b0cfa56c550c8024c8b3e0d68c39e2ac1222b5b74200ebfe11e73b3db2413` and independent review `ac0d4444aac62d3c857de1e32c427226dd22202c5525b49005308d0fa11d0759` are preserved unchanged. The entire 28-file independent packet embeds the exact original 17-file author tree once. All eight source aliases bind exact raw Git blobs and repository paths; no source/receipt normalization or second old-package copy is used.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/one-fusion-compiler-target/verify.py
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/one-fusion-compiler-target/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/one-fusion-compiler-target --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/one-fusion-compiler-target
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/one-fusion-compiler-target --ref HEAD --check-source-history
```

Direct/registered normal/O, metadata/pins, committed bytes/source history, diff check, official export and fresh Git-free read-only replay pass. Full author merge/point receipts and the independent positive-Taylor receipt regenerate byte for byte. The distinct reviewer engine imports no author interval functions. Static GF(2) frame independence/nesting, forward/backward event counts, profile incidence, rank-mass conservation and helper/centre credit checks pass. This does not evaluate amplitudes, absolute phase, contact legality or raw-dual operator correctness. The vendored #5226 verifier, Lean source and round6 generator are reference inputs, not executed.

The fixed scalar screen retains 1024 copies, cutoff/floor 20/21, tail offset 1/5, caps .97 over 128 blocks, maximum productive rank 145, theta 63/64 and power 1000. It verifies the inherited gap/height and the retained pure outer ledger's 54 strict plus four functional positives, including numeric sensitivity controls. These are conditional arithmetic applicability checks, not proof that a changed supplier satisfies C1=1, source normalization, precision/template closure, ordinary BIT/stock or the nine outer cost semantics. No native, Tensor/compiler/emitter/Lean or full 414 helper suite ran. Hosted CI pending.

Contribution head: `cc8cb58ab4083c1cfd58e0e2eb17c0b2a88070a9`.

## Open next questions

Supply one literal eligible native pair with exact event positions, source field/charts, ordered operator and absolute phase, all 632 arbitrary inputs/all ports, both forward and raw inverse-transpose orientations, helper/complement returns and spectators. Prove it can be reused at each of 18 occurrences, or reprice actual partial incidence. Matching rank labels or a standalone Gaussian factorization is insufficient.

Then preserve local scalar 158168, routing 4802000 and whole-controller scalar 181098496 bounds, or supply replacement costs. Keep coefficients/denominators, owned fields/lifetimes, precision/completed-child/template and actual C1/ordinary/outer semantic obligations explicit. If a target, field, correction or bill changes, recompute affected profile/guards before claiming funding. No pair is selected here.
